item.title: Sr. Sigrid Simlik, OP, dies
item.description: Obituaries Sister Sigrid Simlik, OP, died Jan. 23, 2026, at St. Dominic Villa, Hazel Green, Wis. Sister Sigrid Simlik, OP, died Jan. 23, 2026, at St. Dominic Villa, Hazel Green, Wis. Her remembering service will take place 11 a.m. Thursday, Feb. 12 at St. Dominic Villa, and her Funeral Mass will follow. Casey-McNett Funeral Home is handling arrangements.
